title: VP Chemistry & Electromagnetism: Derived from a Single Anchor on the Jamming-Lattice Substrate
description:
DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.20680541

A companion to the VP Theory (physics) whitepaper. Chemistry and electromagnetism are derived from a single anchor (the electron as a rotational dent) using only pi-geometry and the electromagnetic 1/r^2, on the jammed-lattice substrate from which light itself emerges (c^2=B/rho).

The electromagnetism chapter covers light emergence, the Coulomb 1/r^2, the E/B geometry and polarization, the conduction-radiation angle, blackbody radiation, refraction, and the dynamic field equations with Poynting's theorem and light-cone causality. The chemistry chapters cover bonding geometry (VSEPR), coordination color and the crystal-field 4/9, the copper/iron d-shell fates, thermodynamics, equilibrium, kinetics, solution and electrochemistry, materials geometry, and the nuclear magic skeleton. The applications cover catalysis, ammonia synthesis, water electrolysis, energy storage, new materials, and CO2 reduction, all grounded on the verified d-band descriptor (the refuted electron-amplitude mechanism is documented and replaced).

48 deterministic standard-library Python modules (39 core + 9 applications), six case ledgers (222 rows), verification harnesses (core 39/39, apps 9/9), and numeric-drift gates (both pass, zero drift). Every forced result is reproducible and falsifiable; open problems (notably the coupling alpha_em) are admitted in an Open-Items Register.

Reproduce: cd core && python3 code/verify_chemistry.py --root . (39/39 PASS); cd apps && python3 verify_applications.py (9/9 PASS)

Related (Volume I): 10.5281/zenodo.17932567
notes: Open distribution. Documentation/data CC-BY-4.0, code MIT (see licenses/). Reproducibility: core/code/verify_chemistry.py and apps/verify_applications.py.
